verdict.rationale: Clerky's own docs say users can hire employees, consultants, and advisors and issue stock or stock options as equity compensation through the platform, and can adopt a stock plan to issue restricted stock or options. A community user confirms the post-incorporation package includes Hiring. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of offer letters and confidentiality/IP assignment agreements as specific document types, detail on the option-grant workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration of running hiring and equity paperwork end to end.
